hook: Why voice AI keeps saying 'you broke up'.
hookText: OpenAI still has a WebRTC problem

beats.say: Luke Curley, known as kixelated, argues WebRTC is the wrong transport for voice AI, and he says OpenAI's WebRTC experts reached out after his last post.
WebRTC drops late audio to keep calls real-time, but a language model can afford to wait for the missing words.
One second of Opus at 64 kilobits is just 8 kilobytes. Resent over QUIC, that's about six packets instead of fifty.
